meta.ctaTitle: Run your whole store from one place
meta.ctaSub: Start free — no credit card. Upgrade as you grow.

hero.title: Every order, customer and product — structured and yours
hero.lead: Your store runs on a clean, relational database. Products, orders, customers, carts, reviews, bookings and stock all live as connected records you can read, filter and act on — no spreadsheets, no guesswork.

stats.label: Your data is fully isolated from every other store
Orders link to customers, items, payments and returns
Products, orders, customers, bookings, reviews and more
Revenue, funnel and inventory read straight from your data

cards.title: Products
cards.desc: Multi-option products with variations, sizes, per-item pricing and stock.

cards.title: Orders
cards.desc: Every order with its items, totals, payment and delivery — start to finish.

cards.title: Customers
cards.desc: A profile per buyer: contact details, order history and saved addresses.

cards.title: Reviews
cards.desc: Ratings, written reviews and photos tied to the right product.

cards.title: Bookings
cards.desc: Time-based appointments with services, staff and status.

cards.title: Analytics
cards.desc: Revenue, average order value, conversion and inventory, computed live.

deep.title: Records that already know how your store works
deep.body: You never design tables or write queries. Every part of the catalog and every sale is modeled for you, kept consistent, and ready to view, filter and act on from your dashboard.
points: Each store's data is isolated — one store never sees another's
Inventory tracked per warehouse, with batches and low-stock signals
Returns and refunds recorded against the original order
Everything visible in the dashboard — search, filter and drill in

hero.title: Sign-in your customers actually trust
hero.lead: Let shoppers create an account and log in the way they prefer — a one-time email code, their phone number, or a social account — without you building any of it.

stats.label: Google, Apple and 15 more social logins
One-time codes by email or text message
Customers see and revoke their own sessions
Buy first, create the account later

cards.title: Email code
cards.desc: Passwordless one-time codes sent to the customer's inbox.

cards.title: Phone code
cards.desc: SMS one-time codes for phone-first audiences.

cards.title: Social login
cards.desc: Google, Apple, GitHub, Discord and more in one tap.

cards.title: Password reset
cards.desc: A secure, self-serve reset flow out of the box.

cards.title: Sessions
cards.desc: Active devices listed; sign out anywhere, anytime.

cards.title: Guest checkout
cards.desc: Shoppers buy as a guest and upgrade to an account later.

deep.title: All the hard parts are handled for you
deep.body: Tokens, refresh, multi-device sessions and provider callbacks are managed behind the scenes. You switch on the methods you want; your customers just sign in.
points: One-time codes with a short expiry — no passwords to leak
Sessions refresh silently and can be revoked per device
Turn each provider on or off per store
One customer identity can work across all your store's locations

hero.title: Store the images and files your store needs
hero.lead: Upload product photos, review images, and the digital files you sell — almost any file type — straight from the dashboard. Files upload directly and securely, and every store's media stays its own.

stats.label: Media allowance scales with your plan
Images, PDFs and the digital downloads you sell
Files go straight to storage from the browser
Your media is isolated from every other store

cards.title: Product images
cards.desc: Photo galleries per product and per variation.

cards.title: Review photos
cards.desc: Customers attach up to five photos per review.

cards.title: Avatars
cards.desc: Profile pictures for your customers.

cards.title: Email media
cards.desc: Images and PDFs you drop into email campaigns.

cards.title: Digital downloads
cards.desc: Sell digital products — ZIPs, audio, video, e-books, almost any file.

cards.title: Usage tracking
cards.desc: See exactly how much of your allowance you've used.

deep.title: Upload once, use it anywhere
deep.body: Drop a file in and get a link back right away. Storage is metered per plan so you always know where you stand, and each store's files are kept separate.
points: Upload directly from the browser — nothing to set up
Images optimized for fast loading on your storefront
Live usage shown against your plan's allowance
Deleting a store cleanly removes its files

hero.title: Connect your store to everything else you run
hero.lead: When something happens in your store — a paid order, a new customer, a cancelled booking — send it anywhere: Slack, Discord, your own endpoint, or ready-made connectors. Plus alerts and campaigns that run on a schedule.

stats.label: Orders, bookings, customers, payments and products
Slack, Discord, accounting and analytics tools
Alerts and email campaigns that fire on their own
Every send recorded with its status and retries

cards.title: Event webhooks
cards.desc: POST a JSON payload to your endpoint when an event fires.

cards.title: Slack & Discord
cards.desc: Drop order and booking updates into a channel.

cards.title: Connectors
cards.desc: Ready-made links to accounting and analytics tools.

cards.title: Scheduled alerts
cards.desc: Revenue drops, low stock and daily summaries by email.

cards.title: Email campaigns
cards.desc: One-time or recurring sends that run automatically.

cards.title: Delivery logs
cards.desc: See every delivery, its response and automatic retries.

deep.title: Pick an event, choose where it goes
deep.body: Subscribe to the events you care about and route them to the tools your team already uses. Failed deliveries retry on their own, and every attempt is logged.
points: Fourteen event types across orders, bookings, customers and products
Send to a custom endpoint, Slack or Discord
Automatic retries on failure, with a full delivery log
Scheduled alerts and campaigns run without you lifting a finger

hero.title: Email your customers actually receive
hero.lead: Send order confirmations, reminders and marketing campaigns from your own verified domain — written in plain HTML, delivered straight from our mail servers, and tuned to land in the inbox.

stats.label: Send as you@yourbrand.com, fully verified
Messages typically arrive within a few seconds
Built-in transactional emails, all editable
One-time or recurring broadcasts to your customers

cards.title: Transactional
cards.desc: Verification, reset, order, booking, cart and restock emails.

cards.title: Campaigns
cards.desc: Broadcast announcements and promos to your customers.

cards.title: Your domain
cards.desc: Verified sending with DKIM, SPF and DMARC.

cards.title: HTML editor
cards.desc: Write the exact email you want, with a live preview.

cards.title: Scheduling
cards.desc: Send now, at a set time, or on a weekly or yearly repeat.

cards.title: Deliverability
cards.desc: Authenticated sending tuned to reach the inbox.

deep.title: From your domain to the inbox, in seconds
deep.body: Verify your domain once and every email goes out signed and authenticated. Messages leave our servers immediately and typically reach recipients within a few seconds, anywhere in the world.
points: Your own verified domain with DKIM, SPF and DMARC
Six transactional templates, each editable as HTML
Schedule one-time, weekly or once-a-year campaigns
Daily volume scales with your plan

hero.title: Your team, live on the same page
hero.lead: Live presence, cursors and shared editing across your whole CRM. See who's online and where, watch a teammate's cursor move with their name on it, and drop a message right on your pointer — on every project, product and org page.

stats.label: Presence and cursors on every project, product and org screen
See each teammate's pointer, labelled with their name
Watch edits land in a field as they're typed
A single WebSocket per session powers all of it

cards.title: Live presence
cards.desc: An avatar stack in the header and online dots show who's here, in real time.

cards.title: Live cursors
cards.desc: Every teammate's cursor moves live, labelled with their name and pixel-accurate across screens.

cards.title: Cursor chat
cards.desc: Press Ctrl+M to pin a quick message to your cursor — a word in the moment, no thread.

cards.title: Shared editing
cards.desc: Watch a teammate type into an email or product field, mirrored keystroke by keystroke.

cards.title: Jump to a teammate
cards.desc: Open the presence menu and click anyone to land exactly where they're working.

cards.title: Built to scale
cards.desc: One authenticated WebSocket per session, fanned out across instances with Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY.

deep.title: Your CRM, with everyone in the room
deep.body: Open any page and you can see who else is on it, where their cursor is and what they're editing — the moment it happens. No refresh, no plugin, on every screen from a single project to the whole organization.
points: Live presence, cursors and cursor-chat on every project, product and org page
Shared live editing in the email composer and product overview
Element-locked cursors stay pixel-accurate even on different monitors
One authenticated WebSocket, scaled across instances via Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY
